audit.why: Lane reads correctly as a Syndra-favored poke lane (52.37% WR, 1749 games): easy early, easy mid, strong side-lane pick threat, Neeko out-teamfights via disguised R flanks. Prose reflects this.
Spikes recorded: level 2 QE, level 6 Unleashed Power execute, Luden's first item, late one-shot. spikes[] has all 4 entries and matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields claim you dodge Tangle-Barbs by hiding behind minions. Riot's text says the tangle 'damages and roots everything it passes through' and grows larger through champions — minions do not block it; they feed it.
audit.why: Enemy kit E text is explicit; the advice as written gets a player rooted.
audit.corrected: Dodge Tangle-Barbs sideways, never by standing behind the wave; it passes through and grows.

audit.why: Kit gives Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Pop Blossom 120/105/90s; Syndra E 15s.

audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; both bleed bodies replaced with title-matching content.
